svg.title: A stat reduction breaks a shield
svg.desc: Three moments of Debilitate. A glowing shield appears over each target in turn, four frames apart. About 24 frames into each target's turn it shatters into 24 shards that fly away from the caster. The shards then step through seven darker copies of their picture, one every four frames, until they are gone. Dull draws a dagger instead and Weaken draws the shield in pink; because the canvas is halved after each copy, every shard leaves a short trail.
svg.text: Dull draws a dagger instead, Weaken the shield
in pink. The canvas halves after each copy, so
every shard leaves a short trail.
